dialogues.speaker: Kotimy
dialogues.text: Anyway, that's what he calls himself. He can mimic human speech, too! That's probably why Ifa calls him Cacucu...

dialogues.speaker: Kotimy
dialogues.text: Now, I don't know if he truly understands human speech, but he looks pretty cool and I love chatting with him.

dialogues.speaker: Kotimy
dialogues.text: But not for too long, or it'll get in the way of my daily training!
